headings.instructions: Use Chivo for all headings. MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Avoid generic fonts like Inter for headings.

body.instructions: Use for dense data, standard paragraphs, and UI labels. Clean, mechanical, and highly readable.

data_and_metrics.instructions: Use for all door IDs, dimensions, part numbers, QC readouts, and metrics. Gives a precision control-room feel.

background.instructions: Deep Obsidian. Do not use pure gray. The environment must feel like a dark factory floor or precision control room.

surface.instructions: Use stark, solid surfaces. For office dashboards, rely on Grid Borders (Technical look). Tablets must use ultra-dark high-contrast surfaces.

primary.instructions: Safety Amber / Hazard Orange. Use for main CTAs, active states, and critical actions. Do not overuse; let it pop against the dark steel UI.

status.instructions: Critical for QC Pass/Fail and routing stages.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Use 1px solid borders (border-white/10). No soft shadows. Use sharp, industrial, hard-edged containers. Replace shadows with 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights for active items.
visual_enhancers.textures: Blueprint grid textures or subtle grain noise in the background for the login/marketing pages.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must translate on hover (e.g., -translate-y-1). Focus states must have a 2px solid border in Safety Amber.
visual_enhancers.tablet_specific: For the 5 factory stations, eliminate delicate visual flair. Buttons MUST be large (min h-16 or h-20), padding must be generous. Checkboxes and list items must be massive for gloved hands.

layouts.login_page: Cinematic split screen. Left side: immersive dark image of industrial sparks (from image_urls). Right side: strict, brutalist login form with hard borders. Add a Framer Motion reveal for the form.
layouts.office_dashboard: Precision control room. High Density Grid (Bento Grid Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Ensure all table cells and data rows align perfectly.
layouts.factory_tablets: Mobile-first, tablet-optimized. Grid-cols-1 or 2 maximum. High contrast mode. Enormous interactive targets. Simple left-to-right reading flow. Focus on single-task completion (Tick-off lists, QC pass/fail).

motion.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for kinetic reveals. Masked line reveals for the login page.
motion.micro_interactions: Instant, snappy feedback on tablets (no long animations that slow down factory workers). Subdued but precise transitions on the office dashboard.
motion.scrolling: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling on the desktop/office side.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build custom HTML/Tailwind for the Login Page. 2. Use Shadcn components for Office Dashboard (Tables, Dialogs, Select). Customize them to remove the 'Vercel-look' (sharp corners, dark backgrounds, amber focus rings). 3. For factory tablets, build massive custom button and checkbox structures optimized for touch. 4. Never use native <input type='date'>, use Shadcn.

image_urls.description: Person using angle grinder with dramatic sparks in dark industrial setting.
Dark factory environment, suitable for low-opacity background texture behind data.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the #050505 background meets 4.5:1 contrast. Use pure #FFFFFF for primary text.
accessibility.touch_targets: CRITICAL: Tablet screens must have a minimum touch target size of 48x48px, ideally 64x64px for factory operators.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, rows) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'login-submit-btn', 'qc-pass-btn').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST use dark theme. This is a heavy industry app.
Do not use generic SaaS blue. The primary color is Safety Amber (#F59E0B).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the app container. Text should flow naturally left-to-right.
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, technical icons.
NEVER use placeholder images. Only use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Create the 5 distinct factory tablet interfaces (Core, Skin, Assembly, Press, Routing) and Despatch with extreme clarity and massive touch areas.
Create the Office dashboard with detailed tracking tables and job creation forms.
